description: This file contains unit tests for the BandwidthSampler class and related components in the QUIC congestion control module, including test fixtures, test cases for bandwidth estimation, packet acknowledgment, loss, reordering, app-limited scenarios, and acknowledgment aggregation tracking.

classes.name: BandwidthSamplerPeer
classes.description: A helper class providing access to internal state of BandwidthSampler for testing purposes.

classes.name: BandwidthSamplerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for unit tests of BandwidthSampler, providing utility methods and test setup.

classes.name: MaxAckHeightTrackerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing MaxAckHeightTracker behavior in acknowledgment aggregation scenarios.

methods.name: GetNumberOfTrackedPackets
methods.description: Returns the number of packets currently tracked by the BandwidthSampler.

methods.name: GetPacketSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a specific packet tracked by the BandwidthSampler.

methods.name: PacketsToBytes
methods.description: Converts packet count to total bytes based on regular packet size.

methods.name: SendPacketInner
methods.description: Simulates sending a packet with specified packet number and size.

methods.name: SendPacket
methods.description: Simulates sending a packet with the regular packet size.

methods.name: AckPacketInner
methods.description: Acknowledges a packet and returns a bandwidth sample.

methods.name: MakeAckedPacket
methods.description: Creates an AckedPacket object for a given packet number.

methods.name: MakeLostPacket
methods.description: Creates a LostPacket object for a given packet number.

methods.name: AckPacket
methods.description: Acknowledges a packet and returns the bandwidth sample.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Simulates a congestion event with specified acknowledged and lost packets.

methods.name: LosePacket
methods.description: Simulates packet loss and returns the last packet send state.

methods.name: Send40PacketsAndAckFirst20
methods.description: Sends 40 packets and acknowledges the first 20, with specified inter-packet delay.

methods.name: RoundTripCount
methods.description: Calculates the current round trip count based on elapsed time.

methods.name: AggregationEpisode
methods.description: Runs a full acknowledgment aggregation episode for testing MaxAckHeightTracker.
